nodes.label: *Baseline assessments must occur within 2 weeks during the screening period.  The screening period is within 4

Xb  - Once during the week preferably at the first visit of the week.
Xc - At the final scheduled study visit (last visit of week 12) or if the subjects discontinues prematurely.
